applies_to: These expectations were registered before the first run and are not changed by later policy, ruleset or brief versions; each run records its brief (brief_sha) and ruleset, and results are reported per brief.
how_to_read: must_not_fire: rules that firing would make the policy (or the reviewer) wrong. must_fire: rules a working policy has to fire. may_fire: plausible but not required; recorded so a result can't be reinterpreted afterwards. card: expectations about reported, unjudged facts.

real_calm.source: Strumpshaw Fen murmuration (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0), 20-24 s

real_hunt.source: Storms et al. 2019 ESM 1 (Rome, CC BY 4.0), 20-24 s, inside a wave event (16.4-34.4 s), timecode cropped off

page_calm.source: murmuration.html?seed=7&calm, t 10-14 s, defaults (roll scatter 15 deg, clean frames)

page_hunt.source: murmuration.html?seed=8, t 86.53-90.53 s: a hunt, captured from the first wave pulse with the whole flock in frame; pulses at 86.53, 87.40 and 90.02 s

page_trail.source: page_calm with ?trail (TRAIL 0.5 ghosts, as drawn at 60 fps)

page_painted.source: page_calm with ?painted (the old dark purple-blue fills, 77-97 % opaque)

page_roll0.source: page_calm with ?roll=0 (every bird wings-level outside turns and waves)

page_noise8.source: murmuration.html?seed=7&calm&noise=8, t 10-14 s: eight times the measured heading noise; polarisation 0.64-0.89 headless (real flocks about 0.96; the default page 0.97-1.00)

untested_rules.S1-silhouette: no control has wrong bird shapes
untested_rules.S2-flight-mode: no control has rigid, synchronised or slow wings
untested_rules.R6-scene: no control pastes the flock into a mismatched scene
